why: This is longest palindromic substring with a tie-break. Expand around each centre (or use the interval DP that this 1-D DP week has in mind) to find every maximal palindrome. Keep the longest, preferring the lexicographically smaller string on ties, and ignore length-1 answers.
hints: Every palindrome grows symmetrically from a centre: a letter for odd length, a gap for even length.
From each of the 2n-1 centres expand while the ends match. The maximal palindrome at that centre is the only candidate you need from it.
Track (length, string) and replace when longer, or same length and smaller. Return 'None' if the best length is < 2. O(n^2) time, O(1) extra space.
pitfalls: Single characters do not count. A string with no palindrome of length >= 2 returns the literal string 'None'.
On equal length pick the lexicographically smallest, not the first one found.
constraints: • Not stated in the source. Assume 1 ≤ inputStr.length ≤ 1000, uppercase letters A-Z only.
